lines.text: Did you know? Gress is Latin for step.
Quick quiz! Which means toward plus step?

words.ex: You have made great progress with your writing.
The dog next door is quite aggressive.
There was a gradual increase in car ownership.

publish.title: Gress root: progress, aggressive and gradual
publish.value: Gress comes from Latin "gradi" (to step, to walk). Words: progress, aggressive and gradual. progress = pro + gress; aggressive = ag + gress.
